name: Leonie
quote: We had an amazing trip down the Carretera Austral with this cozy mobile home. Josefina and Rodrigo are really sweet and helpful and we were very happy with everything! The car felt reliable and easy to drive and everything is super convenient and comfortable. Josefina and Rodrigo made sure the car comes with all kinds of utensils you need for a comfortable 10 day roadtrip - we very much recommend this company!

name: Josse
quote: Very friendly people and personal contact and service. We had an amazing time in Chile with our 4x4 camper. When we needed help they immediately responded. Definitely recommend renting a camper here!

name: Rhys
quote: Josefina and Rodrigo are the best! Such a kind and helpful couple. It was our first time visiting Chile and they both made us feel welcome. The camper was very easy to use and well set up for any adventure you can think of when visiting Chile. Thanks again South Nomads!

name: Andreas
quote: Super good experience. Very flexible with the date because we arrived a day early on the way back and there was no problem. Very interested in feedback to improve the service. They are a very kind couple.
